🔁 Continuous loop, as stated in your workflow: "Once the first Re‑Inspection RFI is raised, every subsequent cycle follows the same workflow: Contractor → GM → SQC → FE → GM." There is no stated maximum number of repeats — the loop runs until GM finally accepts the FE's survey, at which point the RFI is closed. This is intentionally different from the initial survey (Stage 1), where an FE Reject skips the GM entirely.

See CR‑FH‑03, BR‑FH‑08, BR‑FH‑09 and the new live‑screen tags throughout.
⚠ Still not confirmed by anything provided so far — please confirm before build:
  1. Geo‑tagged photo requirement. Not stated for the Initial Survey or the Re‑Inspection survey, and the provided screenshots don't show the capture form itself (only entry points and result lists). Assumed mandatory on both, consistent with Material Testing/Cube Testing — confirm.
  2. Maximum number of Re‑Inspection cycles / SLA cap. Your text states the loop continues "until the GM finally accepts" with no stated maximum, and none of the report screens shown expose a cap or SLA field. Implemented as uncapped — confirm whether an escalation path should exist.
  3. Mandatory remark on GM Reject. Not explicitly stated or visible in the "Pending For Action" list screenshot (which only shows an Action button, not the underlying detail form). Assumed mandatory so the Contractor knows what to rectify.
  4. Who/what triggers the very first Re‑Inspection RFI. Assumed automatic status change to "Pending Rectification" once FE rejects, with the Contractor then actively raising the RFI — this hand‑off screen (Contractor‑side) wasn't among the screenshots provided.
  5. Named‑FE assignment screen (inside SQC/TPIA). Confirmed that GM only routes to the SQC/TPIA org unit (Screen 9); the screen where SQC/TPIA actually picks a named FE (Screen 11 mockup) was not captured — confirm it exists and where.
  6. Actual Re‑Inspection / Initial Survey data‑entry form. The mobile "Re‑Inspection" screenshot (Screen 13) was captured with no case loaded, and no screenshot of the populated HSC Verification form was provided — Screens 4 and 12 remain mockups pending a populated screenshot.
🗄 DB / state logic: loop_iteration starts at 1 for the Initial Survey and increments by 1 each time the Contractor raises a new Re‑Inspection RFI on the same case. assigned_fe_id is overwritten (not appended) whenever SQC reassigns to a different FE, while fe_history[] retains every FE who has ever worked the case, for audit. Case status values: Pending Survey → Pending GM Approval → Pending Rectification → Pending Re‑Inspection RFI → Pending SQC Assignment → Pending FE Re‑Inspection → Pending GM Decision → Closed (Approved).

Business Rules (BR)

9 rules
IDRuleDescriptionApplies to
BR‑FH‑01Initial Survey decision routingAt the Initial Survey stage only: FE Accept routes to GM for final approval; FE Reject routes DIRECTLY to the Contractor with the GM not involved at all. This differs from every later cycle.Screens 4, 5, 7
BR‑FH‑02Re‑Inspection always routes to GMFrom the first Re‑Inspection RFI onward, the FE's re‑inspection result — whether satisfied or not — is always submitted to GM for decision. There is no direct FE→Contractor path inside the loop.Screen 12, FE Re‑Inspection node
BR‑FH‑03Uncapped continuous Re‑Inspection LoopIf GM rejects the FE's re‑inspection report, the RFI returns to the Contractor and the cycle (Contractor → GM → SQC → FE → GM) repeats. No maximum number of cycles is stated — it continues until GM accepts.Screens 7‑15, GM Decision node
BR‑FH‑04FE reassignment — SQC discretionDuring any Re‑Inspection cycle, SQC may assign the RFI to the same FE or a different FE. Reassignment is optional and operational. If reassigned, only the newly assigned FE may view/act on the RFI; the previous FE loses update access.Screen 11, FE Reassignment scenario
BR‑FH‑05Full history visible to new FEWhen a new FE is assigned, the complete survey history, previous remarks and attachments remain visible to them for reference and audit, even though they cannot edit the previous FE's entries. Confirmed live by the "View Logs" audit trail on Screen 6 (Survey History).Screens 6, 11
BR‑FH‑06loop_iteration counterA counter increments by 1 every time the Contractor raises a new Re‑Inspection RFI on the same case. Starts at 1 for the Initial Survey. Exposed on the RFI Dashboard for monitoring.Screen 16, all Re‑Inspection screens
BR‑FH‑07Same case ID retainedA Re‑Inspection RFI reuses the original case/RFI ID — no new record is created for any cycle of the loop.Screen 7, Re‑Inspection Loop flow
BR‑FH‑08GM assigns to SQC/TPIA org unit, not a named person ⚠ CONFIRMED BY SCREENSHOTScreen 9 (live) shows GM selecting rows and choosing SQC, TPIA or Both via radio button, then clicking Assign — this routes the case to the SQC/TPIA org unit as a whole. This corrects the earlier assumption in FR‑FH‑04 that GM picks a named SQC officer directly; the named‑FE pick (Screen 11 mockup) most likely happens inside the SQC/TPIA's own worklist, which wasn't captured in the provided screenshots.Screens 8, 9
BR‑FH‑09"In Progress" is read‑only tracking, no action ⚠ NEW, from screenshotScreen 10 (live) is a filterable monitoring view only (PIU, Scheme) for cases currently with SQC/TPIA/FE — GM cannot act from this screen. It sits between Step ② and Step ⑤ and wasn't anticipated in the original text‑only workflow.Screen 10
